head: strange_render
method: the labels-derived crossover. Isotonic regression (pool-adjacent-violators, ties pooled, non-decreasing) of P(the human said >=3) against this head's own P(>=3), over all 3085 labeled strange_render pictures scored through the shipped artifact; the crossing is the LOWEST score whose fitted agreement reaches 0.5, and the floor is that crossing rounded UP. Rounded up because a floor rounded down admits material the fit did not vouch for.
reference_pool: all 3085 labeled strange_render pictures, over 850 places
